column1: # Subject metadata for nf-helminth-amplicon.
# SEPARATE FROM THE SAMPLESHEET, DELIBERATELY. A samplesheet row is a
# LIBRARY: which index went in which well, frozen at prep, validated
# against the run. A row here is a SUBJECT: it accumulates corrections
# for years. One subject is usually several libraries - replicates, both
# platforms, re-runs - so folding these fields into the samplesheet would
# duplicate them across rows and turn one correction into an N-row edit.
# It is also a privacy boundary. The samplesheet travels: to the
# sequencing centre, into the run folder, into every results directory.
# This file does not have to, and the pipeline runs perfectly well
# without it.
# JOIN KEY: subject_id, matched against the samplesheet's subject_id
# column. That column is optional and defaults to sample_id, so a study
# with one library per subject needs no extra column at all. Where
# replicates exist, set subject_id explicitly rather than relying on a
# suffix-stripping regex - a convention holds until one identifier
# breaks it, and then it fails silently.
# LOCATION: country and population only. Anything finer is masked before
# it reaches the pipeline. Pre-flight REFUSES a file carrying latitude,
# longitude, GPS, postcode or address columns, because their presence
# means the masking did not happen.
# Every column other than subject_id is free. Add what the study needs;
# nothing here is required, and unknown fields are carried through
# rather than dropped.
subject_id
